title: 4 days left: How TechCrunch Founder Summit helps you make more useful connections to scale
hook_text: Four days left until Boston summit
script:
Four days remain until the TechCrunch Founder Summit begins in Boston.
The event takes place on November fourth at the SoWa Power Station.
Founders gather for a full day packed with networking opportunities and actionable insights.
These targeted connections change the trajectory of your idea and scaling startup.
Registration prices go up at the door so tickets must be bought early.
The TechCrunch Founder Summit helps you make more useful connections to scale.
